description: Cloudian® HyperStore® is a software-defined object storage platform that provides a secure multi-tenant data store for unstructured data. HyperStore object storage can be deployed and scaled out as a global cluster of nodes to deliver capacity storage which scales seamlessly. It's the industry's most compatible S3 API based object storage solution.
